definition: **Cho-Do classification 依據 nidus 分 4 型，Type II（多條 arteriole 匯入單一 outflow vein）最佳栓塞方式為 transvenous approach 或 direct puncture（非 transarterial）。**
keyPoints: Type I：≤3 feeders + 1 outflow vein → transarterial
Type II：多條 arterioles + single outflow vein → **transvenous 或 direct puncture**
Type IIIa：多支 feeder + multiple non-dilated shunts → direct puncture + transarterial
Type IIIb：多支 feeder + multiple dilated shunts → direct puncture + transarterial
name: Peripheral AVM Cho-Do Classification
